title: Merge to Ten
description: Tap connected groups of identical digits to fuse them into the next number up—keep your grid open and race to craft the elusive 10 tile!
controls: Tap clusters of two or more matching adjacent numbers to merge them into a higher digit.

zh-CN.title: 数字合成十
zh-CN.description: 极简烧脑数字益智数字合成十：点击相连相同数字原地合体 +1，步步规划空间挑战合出终极数字 10！
zh-CN.controls: 点击两个及以上相邻相同数字即可就地合成更大数字，一路冲刺合成 10 甚至更高。
